lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₁₀Sn₂Sb₄ (reduced formula Mg₅SnSb₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg and Sb each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Sn has 12 neighbors (4 Mg, 2 Sn, 6 Sb) across distances of 3.15–3.27 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and face-sharing between Mg- and Sb-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, with corner-sharing also observed between Mg-centered polyhedra.
